"Well it certainly has been fun roasting myself alive, but I'd say it's about time to show this wanna-be volcano what a REAL eruption looks like.  No disrespect to one of my very few elders intended, of course."

Absolute Zero

HP:  17

Hand:  Focused Apertures (2), Frost-Bound Drain, Isothermic Transducer, Thermal Shockwave, Coolant Blast, Impale, Modular Realignment.

In Play:  Isothermic Transducer, Cold Snap, Null-Point Calibration Unit (also affected by Visionary's Twist the Ether, which is used exclusively to increase his damage in this turn, only once changing its type).

Trash:  Glacial Structure, Onboard Module Installation, Frost-Bound Drain, Hoarfire.

-------------------------

Start of Turn:  Cold Snap deals 3 net cold damage to Akash'bhuta [18] and 4 infernal damage to Abominable Snowman [5].  3 cold damage has been dealt.

Play a Card:  Thermal Shockwave.

Use a Power:  Thermal Shockwave.  AZ deals 4 cold damage to himself which instead heals him [21].  AZ deals 3 net cold damage to Akash'bhuta [15]; 6 cold damage has been dealt.  AZ deals 4 cold damage to Raptor Bot Curly ("I always preferred Shemp"); 10 cold damage has been dealt.  AZ deals 13 fire damage to himself [8] which Transduces into 16 damage to Akash'bhuta, which she reduces by just 1 [DEAD].

Draw a Card:  Game is over.

End of Turn:

-------------------------

HP:  8

Hand:  Focused Apertures (2), Frost-Bound Drain, Isothermic Transducer, Coolant Blast, Impale, Modular Realignment.

In Play:  Isothermic Transducer, Cold Snap, Null-Point Calibration Unit, Thermal Shockwave

Trash:  Glacial Structure, Onboard Module Installation, Frost-Bound Drain, Hoarfire

Effects:  Cold damage to AZ becomes the same amount of healing instead.  Whenever AZ is dealt fire damage, he deals that much cold damage to any target.

********************

Welp, that was awesome.  As usual, I shall report the game, both on the statistics thread and on this weekend's challenge.  Thanks for accepting my input on the choice of foe and venue y'all...if you want to fight the Dreamer next I'd be happy to get in on that as well, as long as it's not in the Wasteland, the Block, or Insula Primalis (and I could consider The Block).

posts.name: Envisioner
posts.cooked: A better question is whether Thermal Shockwave counts the outgoing cold damage or only the net damage which is successfully dealt.  Damage reduced by Akash's shields, damage to Abominable Snowman or Cryo Bot who are immune (if the damage isn't Twisted to not be Cold anymore), even damage to AZ himself which the NPCU replaces with healing...all of this might have counted, and if so I'd have had to do my calculations more carefully, possibly not selecting extra targets for the Shockwave, possibly plummeting lower in HP as I went boom.  But I'm fairly certain that 16-1 is the minimum damage I was able to deal with the final blast, and that I could have arranged to avoid killing myself in the process.  I might also have had a Shockwave hit go on Cryo Bot and be Wrested down to 2 non-cold damage so as not to kill him, adding an extra 2 cold damage to Abby that way; that would have been amusing but probably suboptimal.  One way or another, I felt fairly confident I could pull it off, and it appears I was right.  An epic ending to a game I was very happy to be involved in.
